rationale: The description establishes phone connectivity and access to captioning, a communications accessibility function. It does not say how captions are produced, leaving the captioning mechanism unresolved.
evidence_spans: the system will connect the Cisco phones in network to the captioning service.
employees who need captioning service can gain access while using their Cisco phone.
conflict_response: The text explicitly supports conventional phone-to-service connection and access, but the service's caption-production mechanism is not described. Since captioning could be human-provided or use AI, neither proposition is established by this description. I retain non_ai for lack of an affirmative AI claim, but mark the binary weak/forced rather than claiming supported non-AI functionality for the entire service.
